source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 1 (PDF 4-21), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 (Measurements) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. In mein definitions, SI units aur un ke usool, prefixes, scientific notation, significant figures aur rounding, uncertainty (ghair-yaqeeni), precision aur accuracy aur dimensions Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein poochhe gaye hain. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Differentiate between base quantities and derived quantities.
(Base quantities aur derived quantities mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Base quantities aazad (independent) hain; derived quantities base quantities par munhasir (depend) hain.

book_ref.quote: Base quantities are not defined in terms of other physical quantities.

rows: Aazad (independent) quantities; kisi aur quantity se define nahi hotin.
Base quantities par munhasir (depend); unhi se define hoti hain.
Baqi physical quantities in se define hoti hain.
Yeh base quantities se banti hain.

blocks.prompt:
2 What two steps are involved in the measurement of a base quantity?
(Kisi base quantity ki peemaish (measurement) mein kaun se do qadam hote hain?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Aik standard (mayaar) chunna.
(ii) Quantity ko standard se muqabla (compare) karne ka tareeqa, taake us ki peemaish aik number aur aik unit ki shakal mein mil jaye.

book_ref.quote: The measurement of a base quantity involves two steps

blocks.prompt:
3 Why must physical quantities be measured accurately?
(Physical quantities ko durust (accurately) naapna kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Physics ke qawaneen (laws) physical quantities ki shakal mein likhe jaate hain, aur physics aik tajurbati (experimental) science hai jis ka scientific method durust peemaish maangta hai. Is liye mass, length, time waghera durust aur qabil-e-aitmaad (reliable) tor par naapni chahiye.

book_ref.quote: The foundation of physics depends on physical quantities in terms of which the laws of Physics are expressed.

blocks.prompt:
4 What is meant by SI? When was it established?
(SI se kya muraad hai? Yeh kab qaim hua?)
blocks.explanation: SI (System International) physical quantities ki definitions aur standards ka nizaam hai jis par 1960 mein aik international committee ne ittifaq kiya. Saari duniya ke scientists isay istemal karte hain; is mein do qisam ke units hain: base units aur derived units.

book_ref.quote: In 1960, an international committee agreed on a set of definitions and standards to describe the physical quantities.

blocks.prompt:
5 Write the SI base units, with symbols, of thermodynamic temperature, intensity of light and amount of substance.
(Thermodynamic temperature, roshni ki shiddat (intensity of light) aur amount of substance ke SI base units symbols ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Thermodynamic temperature: kelvin (K)
Intensity of light: candela (cd)
Amount of substance (maadde ki miqdaar): mole (mol)

book_ref.quote: There are seven base units for physical quantities namely: length, mass, time, temperature, electric current, light or luminous intensity and amount of substance

blocks.prompt:
6 Write the SI units of plane angle and solid angle. Since when are they treated as derived units?
(Plane angle aur solid angle ke SI units likhein. Yeh kab se derived units mein shaamil hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Plane angle: radian (rad); solid angle: steradian (sr). Dono dimensionless (be-dimension) hain.
Yeh 1995 se derived units ki fehrist mein shaamil hain.

book_ref.quote: The units of plane angle and solid angle have also been included in the list of derived units since 1995.

blocks.prompt:
7 Express the SI units of power, pressure and electric charge in terms of base units.
(Power, pressure aur electric charge ke SI units ko base units mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Power: watt, W = J s⁻¹ = kg m² s⁻³
Pressure (dabao): pascal, Pa = N m⁻² = kg m⁻¹ s⁻²
Electric charge: coulomb, C = A s

book_ref.quote: Derived units are those units which depend on the base units.

blocks.prompt:
8 Name any four additional units that the SI permits besides base and derived units.
(Base aur derived units ke ilawa SI jin izafi (additional) units ki ijazat deta hai, un mein se koi chaar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Koi chaar: degree, arcminute, arcsecond (angle); minute, hour, day, year (waqt); litre (volume) aur tonne (mass); electron volt; bel ya decibel; nautical mile aur knot; acre aur hectare; bar (pressure); angstrom aur barn.

book_ref.quote: In addition to base and derived units, the SI permits the use of certain additional units, including:

blocks.prompt:
9 Why should we write "s" and not "sec" for second, and "A" not "amp" for ampere?
(Second ke liye "sec" ke bajaye "s" aur ampere ke liye "amp" ke bajaye "A" kyun likhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har SI unit aik symbol (alamat) se likha jaata hai, abbreviation (mukhaffaf) se nahi. Symbols tamam zabanon mein aik jaise hain, is liye sahi symbol hi likhein: second ke liye s, ampere ke liye A.

book_ref.quote: Each SI is represented by a symbol not an abbreviation.

blocks.prompt:
10 The unit of force is written as "newton" but its symbol is "N". Explain.
(Force ka unit "newton" likha jaata hai magar us ka symbol "N" hai. Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Unit ka poora naam capital harf se shuru nahi hota (Celsius ke siwa), is liye newton likhte hain.
Magar jo symbol kisi scientist ke naam par ho us ka pehla harf capital hota hai, is liye symbol N hai (isi tarah Pa, W).

book_ref.quote: Symbols named after scientists have initial letters capital.

blocks.prompt:
11 Which unit symbol is written as a capital letter although it is not named after a scientist?
(Kaun sa unit symbol capital harf mein likha jaata hai halaanke woh kisi scientist ke naam par nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Unit symbols chhote harf (lower case) mein likhe jaate hain (metre ke liye m, second ke liye s). Istisna (exception) litre hai jis ka symbol capital L hai.

book_ref.quote: Symbols appear in lower case. For example: “m” for metre, “s” for second, etc., exception “L” for litre.

blocks.prompt:
12 Correct the following: (i) 60 kgs (ii) 20 m L (iii) 5 Kg
(In ki tasheeh (correction) karein: (i) 60 kgs (ii) 20 m L (iii) 5 Kg)
blocks.explanation:
(i) 60 kg: symbols ki jama (plural) nahi banti.
(ii) 20 mL: prefix unit se pehle baghair faasle (space) ke likha jaata hai.
(iii) 5 kg: unit symbols chhote harf (lower case) mein hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Symbols do not take plural form. For example: 1 mm, 100 mm, 1 kg, 60 kg.

blocks.prompt:
13 How are unit symbols printed in a sentence written in italic type?
(Italic (tirchhe) harfon mein likhe jumle mein unit symbols kaise chhapte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Symbols aur prefixes hamesha seedhe (upright, roman) harfon mein chhapte hain, aas paas ki likhai jaisi bhi ho, maslan a distance of 50 m.

book_ref.quote: Symbols and prefixes are printed in upright (roman) style regardless of the type style in surrounding text.

blocks.prompt:
14 Is it correct to write a speed of ten metres per second as 10ms⁻¹? Explain.
(Das metre per second speed ko 10ms⁻¹ likhna kya durust hai? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Nahi. Mila kar likhne se "ms" ka matlab millisecond ho jaata hai, kyun ke prefix unit se pehle baghair faasle ke likha jaata hai.
Base units ke darmiyan aik space, aur number aur symbol ke darmiyan bhi space: 10 m s⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: Base units are written one space apart. Leave a space even between the number (value) and the symbol.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: m s mein space na ho to m ko metre ke bajaye milli (10⁻³) prefix samjha jaata hai. Is liye unit likhte waqt space ka khayal zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt:
15 Is a full stop placed after a unit symbol, as in "5 kg."?
(Kya unit symbol ke baad full stop lagta hai, jaise "5 kg."?)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Unit symbol ke baad full stop ya dot nahi lagta, siwaye jumle ke aakhir mein: "5 kg" likhein, "5 kg." nahi.

book_ref.quote: No fullstop or dot is placed after the symbol except at the end of the sentence.

blocks.prompt:
16 Are compound prefixes allowed in SI? Write 1 µµF correctly.
(Kya SI mein compound (dohre) prefixes ki ijazat hai? 1 µµF ko sahi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Nahi, compound prefixes ki ijazat nahi.
µµ = 10⁻⁶ × 10⁻⁶ = 10⁻¹², jo pico hai, is liye 1 µµF ko 1 pF likhein.

book_ref.quote: Compound prefixes are not allowed: For example: 1 µµF should be 1 pF.

blocks.prompt:
17 Express 5 cm² in m².
(5 cm² ko m² mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Power poore multiple par lagti hai, sirf base unit par nahi:
5 cm² = 5 (cm)² = 5 × (10⁻² m)² = 5 × 10⁻⁴ m²

book_ref.quote: When base unit of multiple is raised to a power, the power applies to whole multiple and not to base unit alone.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Aksar talaba 5 cm² = 5 × 10⁻² m² likh dete hain, jo ghalat hai; centi (10⁻²) ka bhi square hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
18 Correct the units "metre/sec" and "m/second".
("metre/sec" aur "m/second" units ki tasheeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Aik hi expression mein symbols aur naam mila kar nahi likhte, aur solidus (/) ke bajaye negative index likhte hain.
Sahi shakal: metre per second, ya m s⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: Do not mix symbols and names in the same expression.

blocks.prompt:
19 In which units should screw gauge readings be recorded during practical work?
(Practical kaam mein screw gauge ki readings kis unit mein likhni chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Practical kaam aale ke liye sab se aasan unit mein likha jaata hai: screw gauge ki readings mm mein. Aakhri natija (final result) munasib base units mein likha jaye.

book_ref.quote: Measurements using screw gauge should be recorded in mm but the final results must be recorded to the appropriate base units.

blocks.prompt:
20 Can dyne and erg be used as units in SI?
(Kya SI mein dyne aur erg units istemal ho sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. SI purane CGS units, maslan dyne, erg, gauss, poise aur torr, ki ijazat nahi deta.

book_ref.quote: System International do not allow the use of former CGS System units such as dyne, erg, gauss, poise, Tor, etc.

blocks.prompt:
21 Using E = mc², find the energy equivalent to a mass of 2 g. (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)
(E = mc² se 2 g mass ke barabar energy maloom karein. (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹))
blocks.explanation:
m = 2 g = 2 × 10⁻³ kg
E = mc² = 2 × 10⁻³ kg × (3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)² = 1.8 × 10¹⁴ J

book_ref.quote: According to this equation 1 kg mass is actually 9 × 10¹⁶ J energy.

blocks.prompt:
22 Express one day in seconds in scientific notation.
(Aik din ko seconds mein scientific notation ki shakal mein likhein.)

book_ref.quote: Approximate Values of Some Time Intervals (For Your Information)

blocks.prompt:
23 Why are prefixes used with units?
(Units ke saath prefixes kyun istemal kiye jaate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aksar prefixes 1000 ke qadmon mein order of magnitude (miqdaar ka darja) batate hain. In se bohat bari aur bohat chhoti numbers aasani se likhi jaati hain aur ghair-zaroori (non-significant) hindse khatam hote hain, maslan 5000 m = 5 km.

book_ref.quote: Most prefixes indicate order of magnitude in steps of 1000 and provide a convenient way to express large and small numbers, to eliminate non-significant digits.

blocks.prompt:
24 Name the four SI prefixes that are not in steps of 1000. Why are they included?
(Woh chaar SI prefixes likhein jo 1000 ke qadmon mein nahi. Inhein kyun shaamil kiya gaya?)
blocks.explanation:
centi (10⁻²), deci (10⁻¹), deka (10¹) aur hecto (10²).
Inhein is liye rakha gaya ke SI se pehle in ka istemal pehle se raaij (established) tha.

book_ref.quote: SI also includes four of the other prefixes to accommodate usage already established before the introduction of SI

blocks.prompt:
25 Write using suitable prefixes: (i) 4.7 × 10⁻⁹ s (ii) 2.3 × 10⁶ W (iii) 6 × 10⁻¹² m
(Munasib prefixes ke saath likhein: (i) 4.7 × 10⁻⁹ s (ii) 2.3 × 10⁶ W (iii) 6 × 10⁻¹² m)
blocks.explanation:
(i) 4.7 × 10⁻⁹ s = 4.7 ns (nano = 10⁻⁹)
(ii) 2.3 × 10⁶ W = 2.3 MW (mega = 10⁶)
(iii) 6 × 10⁻¹² m = 6 pm (pico = 10⁻¹²)

book_ref.quote: Table 1.3 Some Prefixes for Powers of Ten

blocks.prompt:
26 How many nanoseconds are there in one millisecond?
(Aik millisecond mein kitne nanoseconds hain?)
blocks.explanation:
1 ms = 10⁻³ s aur 1 ns = 10⁻⁹ s
1 ms / 1 ns = 10⁻³ / 10⁻⁹ = 10⁶, is liye 1 ms = 10⁶ ns.

book_ref.quote: Most prefixes indicate order of magnitude in steps of 1000

blocks.prompt:
27 What is meant by scientific notation? Write 0.000506 m in it.
(Scientific notation se kya muraad hai? 0.000506 m ko is mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Scientific notation (standard form) mein number ko das ki powers ke saath likhte hain, aur decimal se pehle sirf aik ghair-sifar (non-zero) hindsa hota hai.
0.000506 m = 5.06 × 10⁻⁴ m

book_ref.quote: The internationally accepted practice is that there should be only one non-zero digit left of decimal.

blocks.prompt:
28 We can count the pages of a book exactly, but we cannot measure its length exactly. Why?
(Kitab ke safhe hum theek theek gin sakte hain magar us ki lambai theek theek nahi naap sakte. Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Ginti bilkul durust hoti hai, magar lambai ke liye aala (instrument) chahiye. Har aale par aik sab se chhoti division hoti hai jo us ki durusti ki had hai; reading qareeb tareen nishan tak li jaati hai, is liye har naapi gayi lambai mein kuch uncertainty (ghair-yaqeeni) hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Every instrument is calibrated to a certain smallest division mark on it and this fact puts a limit regarding its accuracy.

blocks.prompt:
29 Differentiate between absolute uncertainty and percentage uncertainty.
(Absolute uncertainty aur percentage uncertainty mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Absolute uncertainty quantity ki unit mein hoti hai; percentage uncertainty naapi gayi qeemat se nisbat (ratio) × 100 hai.

book_ref.quote: This is called absolute uncertainty. It is one millimetre on a metre rule that is graduated in millimetres.

rows: Zyada se zyada uncertainty, aale ki aik sab se chhoti division (least count).
Quantity ki unit mein, maslan mm wale metre rule ke liye 1 mm.
Is ki koi unit nahi; % mein likhte hain.

blocks.prompt:
30 On a metre rule graduated in mm, one end of a rod is at the 2.0 cm mark and the other at the 17.5 cm mark. Write the length of the rod with its uncertainty.
(mm wale metre rule par rod ka aik sira 2.0 cm aur doosra 17.5 cm ke nishan par hai. Rod ki lambai uncertainty ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Har reading mein ±0.05 cm uncertainty hai.
Lambai = (17.5 ± 0.05) cm − (2.0 ± 0.05) cm = 15.5 ± 0.1 cm
Uncertainty 0.1 cm metre rule ke least count ke barabar hai.

book_ref.quote: Hence, the maximum uncertainty is ±0.05 cm, which is equivalent to an uncertainty of 0.1 cm.

blocks.prompt:
31 A length is recorded as 20.0 ± 0.1 cm. Find its fractional and percentage uncertainty.
(Aik lambai 20.0 ± 0.1 cm likhi gayi hai. Is ki fractional aur percentage uncertainty maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Fractional uncertainty = absolute uncertainty / naapi gayi qeemat = 0.1 cm / 20.0 cm = 0.005
Percentage uncertainty = 0.005 × 100 = 0.5%

book_ref.quote: Uncertainty may be recorded as:

blocks.prompt:
32 What does a fluctuation of more than 2 in the last digit of a digital instrument indicate?
(Digital aale ke aakhri hindse mein 2 se zyada utaar charhao (fluctuation) kya zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ka matlab ho sakta hai ke reading par koi aur asar hai, maslan hawa ke jhonke (air currents). Wajah jo bhi ho, itna zyada utaar charhao batata hai ke dikhaya gaya hindsa asal mein significant nahi.

book_ref.quote: Regardless of the reason, a large fluctuation may mean that the displayed digit is not really significant.

blocks.prompt:
33 What does the last digit of a measurement recorded with correct significant figures indicate?
(Sahi significant figures ke saath likhi gayi peemaish ka aakhri hindsa kya zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aakhri hindsa andaza (estimation), yani mashkook hindsa hai. Yeh likhi gayi qeemat ki accuracy (durusti) batata hai; yun significant figures khud peemaish ki uncertainty dikhate hain.

book_ref.quote: then its last digit, which is an estimation, is an indication of the accuracy of the recorded value.

blocks.prompt:
34 Why is it better to quote a result in scientific notation?
(Natija scientific notation mein likhna kyun behtar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Scientific notation se significant figures ki tadaad mein koi shak nahi rehta, kyun ke das ki power ke ilawa sab hindse significant hote hain, maslan 8.00 × 10³ kg mein saaf 3 significant figures hain.

book_ref.quote: It is better to quote the result in scientific notation to avoid any ambiguity regarding the number of significant figures.

blocks.prompt:
35 Why should the result of a calculator be rounded off?
(Calculator ke jawab ko round off kyun karna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Calculator utne hindse deta hai jitni us ki memory ijazat de. Yeh izafi hindse doosron ko ghalat-fehmi mein daal sakte hain, is liye jawab ko aale ke least count ko dekh kar sahi significant figures tak round off karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The additional digits may mislead another person who uses those figures into believing them.

blocks.prompt:
36 The mass of an object is reported as 5.274 g by one balance and 5.3 g by another. Which is more accurate and why?
(Aik cheez ki mass aik balance par 5.274 g aur doosre par 5.3 g likhi gayi. Kaun si zyada accurate hai aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation: 5.274 g zyada accurate hai. Is mein significant figures zyada hain (4 ke muqable mein 2), jo batata hai ke behtar aur zyada precise aala istemal hua.

book_ref.quote: the reported mass 3.145 g is more accurate than a reported mass of 3.1 g

blocks.prompt:
37 A mass is quoted as 3.1 g without any uncertainty. What uncertainty is understood?
(Aik mass baghair uncertainty ke 3.1 g likhi gayi hai. Is mein kitni uncertainty samjhi jaati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Samjha jaata hai ke likhe gaye number ke aakhri hindse mein kam az kam 1 unit ki uncertainty hai. Is liye 3.1 g ka matlab 3.1 ± 0.1 g hai.

book_ref.quote: it is understood that the number quoted has an uncertainty of at least 1 unit in the last digit.

blocks.prompt:
38 How can the experimental accuracy of a result be improved?
(Kisi natije ki tajurbati durusti (experimental accuracy) kaise behtar ki ja sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Naapne wale aale aur tareeqe (technique) ka maeyaar behtar kar ke. Is se natija zyada significant figures tak likha ja sakta hai aur us ki accuracy barh jaati hai.

book_ref.quote: As we improve the quality of our measuring instrument and techniques, we extend the result to more and more significant figures

blocks.prompt:
39 When are zeros significant in a measurement?
(Kisi peemaish mein zeros (sifar) kab significant hote hain?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Do significant figures ke darmiyan zero significant hai (maslan 405).
(ii) Significant figures ke baayein zeros significant nahi (maslan 0.00467).
(iii) Decimal number mein kisi significant figure ke daayein zeros significant hain (maslan 3.570).

book_ref.quote: A zero between two significant figures is itself significant.

blocks.prompt:
40 A mass is recorded as 5000 g. How many significant figures does it have if the least count of the balance is (i) 1 g (ii) 100 g?
(Aik mass 5000 g likhi gayi hai. Agar balance ka least count (i) 1 g (ii) 100 g ho to is mein kitne significant figures hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Integer (poore number) mein significant zeros ki tadaad aale ki precision par munhasir hai.
(i) Least count 1 g: 5.000 × 10³ g, 4 significant figures.
(ii) Least count 100 g: 5.0 × 10³ g, 2 significant figures.

book_ref.quote: the number of significant zeros is determined by the precision of the measuring instrument.

blocks.prompt:
41 How many significant figures are there in (i) 0.0070 m (ii) 6.020 × 10⁵ kg? Give reasons.
((i) 0.0070 m (ii) 6.020 × 10⁵ kg mein kitne significant figures hain? Wajah likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) 0.0070 m: 2 (baayein ke zeros significant nahi; decimal mein 7 ke daayein wala zero significant hai).
(ii) 6.020 × 10⁵ kg: 4 (scientific notation mein das ki power ke ilawa tamam hindse significant hain).

book_ref.quote: When a measurement is recorded in scientific notation or standard form, the figures other than the powers of ten are significant figures.

blocks.prompt:
42 State the rule for rounding off a number when the digit to be dropped is 5.
(Jab girane wala hindsa 5 ho to round off karne ka usool bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Agar girane wala hindsa 5 ho to pichla hindsa taaq (odd) ho to aik barha dein, aur juft (even) ho to waisa hi rehne dein.
Maslan 92.35 → 92.4 (3 taaq hai); 7.465 → 7.46 (6 juft hai).

book_ref.quote: If the digit to be dropped is 5, the previous digit which is to be retained is increased by one if it is odd and retained as such if it is even.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yeh kitab ka usool hai: 5 girne par sirf pichle hindse ko dekhein. Taaq (1, 3, 5, 7, 9) ho to barhayein, juft (0, 2, 4, 6, 8) ho to na barhayein.

blocks.prompt:
43 Round off to three significant figures: (i) 4.3271 (ii) 6.0827 (iii) 27.65
(Teen significant figures tak round off karein: (i) 4.3271 (ii) 6.0827 (iii) 27.65)
blocks.explanation:
(i) 4.3271 → 4.33 (girne wala hindsa 7 > 5, is liye 2 ka 3)
(ii) 6.0827 → 6.08 (girne wala hindsa 2 < 5, pichla hindsa waisa hi)
(iii) 27.65 → 27.6 (girne wala 5 hai aur 6 juft hai, is liye waisa hi)

book_ref.quote: If the first digit dropped is more than 5, the digit to be retained is increased by one.

blocks.prompt:
44 The length, breadth and thickness of a sheet are 1.50 m, 0.82 m and 0.60 cm. Find its volume to the correct significant figures.
(Aik chaadar (sheet) ki lambai, chaurai aur motai 1.50 m, 0.82 m aur 0.60 cm hai. Is ka volume sahi significant figures tak maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
V = ℓ × b × h = 1.50 m × 0.82 m × 0.60 × 10⁻² m = 7.38 × 10⁻³ m³
0.82 m aur 0.60 cm mein sab se kam significant figures (do) hain, is liye V = 7.4 × 10⁻³ m³.

book_ref.quote: As the factor 0.95 cm has minimum number of significant figures equal to two

blocks.prompt:
45 A box of mass 2.45 kg (lever balance) holds two coins of masses 5.01 g and 5.03 g (beam balance). Find the total mass to the appropriate precision.
(2.45 kg mass ke dabbe (lever balance) mein 5.01 g aur 5.03 g ke do sikke (beam balance) rakhe gaye. Kul mass munasib precision tak maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Kul mass = 2.45 kg + 0.00501 kg + 0.00503 kg = 2.46004 kg
Sab se kam precise mass 2.45 kg mein do decimal places hain, is liye kul mass = 2.46 kg.

book_ref.quote: Since least precise mass is 3.25 kg, having two decimal places

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Jama aur tafreeq mein significant figures nahi, decimal places ginein. Pehle sab masses ko aik unit (kg) mein badlein, phir jama karein.

blocks.prompt:
46 How is the uncertainty in the average value of many readings estimated?
(Bohat si readings ki ausat (average) qeemat mein uncertainty kaise maloom karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Uncertainty ke thumb rule ke mutabiq: kai readings ki ausat mein uncertainty readings ke us ausat se mean deviation (ausat inhiraf) ke barabar li jaati hai.

book_ref.quote: Mean deviation from an average value.

blocks.prompt:
47 The time for 20 oscillations of a pendulum is 36.0 s, measured by a stopwatch of least count 0.1 s. Find the time period with its uncertainty.
(Pendulum ki 20 oscillations (jhoolon) ka waqt 0.1 s least count wali stopwatch se 36.0 s naapa gaya. Time period uncertainty ke saath maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
T = 36.0 s / 20 = 1.80 s
Periodic uncertainty = least count / oscillations ki tadaad = 0.1 s / 20 = 0.005 s
T = 1.800 ± 0.005 s

book_ref.quote: Periodic Uncertainty: Divide least count of timing device by the number of oscillations.

blocks.prompt:
48 Why may the total uncertainty in a measurement be more than its significant figures suggest?
(Peemaish ki kul uncertainty us ke significant figures se zyada kyun ho sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Significant figures sirf aik zariye (source) ki uncertainty batate hain, yani scale parhna. Asal tajurbe mein zaati (personal) ghaltiyan aur kabhi chhupi hui systematic ghaltiyan bhi hoti hain, is liye kul uncertainty zyada ho sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: Significant figures deal with only one source of uncertainties that inherent in reading the scale.

blocks.prompt:
49 What is meant by precision of a measurement? On what does it depend?
(Peemaish ki precision se kya muraad hai? Yeh kis cheez par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Precision peemaish ki absolute uncertainty (least count) se zahir hoti hai. Yeh istemal hone wale aale par munhasir hai: least count jitna chhota, peemaish utni zyada precise.

book_ref.quote: The precision of a measurement is determined by the instrument or device being used. The smaller the least count the more precise is the measurement.

blocks.prompt:
50 Define accuracy. How is it expressed?
(Accuracy ki tareef (definition) karein. Isay kaise zahir karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Accuracy (durusti) peemaish ka quantity ki asal ya maani hui qeemat ke qareeb hona hai. Yeh fractional ya percentage uncertainty se zahir hoti hai: percentage uncertainty jitni kam, peemaish utni zyada accurate.

book_ref.quote: Accuracy is defined as the closeness of a measurement to the exact or accepted value of a physical quantity.

blocks.prompt:
51 A length of 12.0 cm is measured by a metre rule (least count 0.1 cm) and a thickness of 0.36 cm by Vernier Callipers (least count 0.01 cm). Which is more precise and which is more accurate?
(12.0 cm lambai metre rule (least count 0.1 cm) se aur 0.36 cm motai Vernier Callipers (least count 0.01 cm) se naapi gayi. Kaun si zyada precise aur kaun si zyada accurate hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Metre rule: % uncertainty = (0.1/12.0) × 100 = 0.8%; Vernier: (0.01/0.36) × 100 = 2.8%
Vernier ki reading zyada precise hai (chhota least count); metre rule ki reading zyada accurate hai (kam % uncertainty).

book_ref.quote: Thus, the reading 25.5 cm taken by metre rule is although less precise but is more accurate having less percentage uncertainty or error.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Thumb rule yaad rakhein: precision = kam absolute uncertainty; accuracy = kam percentage uncertainty. Is liye kam precise aala bhi bari cheez ko zyada accurately naap sakta hai.

blocks.prompt:
52 Which instrument should be used to measure a small length such as 0.45 cm, and why?
(0.45 cm jaisi chhoti lambai naapne ke liye kaun sa aala istemal karna chahiye aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Quantity jitni chhoti ho, aala utna zyada precise hona chahiye. Micrometer screw gauge (least count 0.001 cm) istemal karein, taake percentage uncertainty kam ho.

book_ref.quote: The smaller a physical quantity, the more precise instrument should be used.

blocks.prompt:
53 Can we make an exact measurement? Explain.
(Kya hum bilkul theek (exact) peemaish kar sakte hain? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi, bilkul theek peemaish kabhi mumkin nahi. Har aale ki precision ki aik had hai, is liye hum zyada se zyada aale ki had ke andar asal qeemat ke jitna qareeb ho sake pohanch sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: We can never make an exact measurement.

blocks.text: 1.6 Assessment of total uncertainty in the final result

blocks.prompt:
54 How is total uncertainty found in (i) a sum or difference (ii) a product or quotient? Differentiate.
(Kul uncertainty (i) jama ya tafreeq (ii) zarb ya taqseem mein kaise maloom hoti hai? Farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Jama ya tafreeq mein absolute uncertainties jama hoti hain; zarb ya taqseem mein percentage uncertainties jama hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: For addition and subtraction: Absolute uncertainties are added.

rows: Natija kul absolute uncertainty ke saath, maslan 21.1 ± 0.2 cm.
Kul % uncertainty ko wapas absolute mein badalte hain, maslan R = 5.0 ± 0.5 ohm.

blocks.prompt:
55 Two positions are x₁ = 12.3 ± 0.1 cm and x₂ = 20.8 ± 0.1 cm. Find the distance between them with uncertainty.
(Do muqamaat x₁ = 12.3 ± 0.1 cm aur x₂ = 20.8 ± 0.1 cm hain. Un ka darmiyani faasla uncertainty ke saath maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tafreeq mein absolute uncertainties jama hoti hain.
x = x₂ − x₁ = 20.8 cm − 12.3 cm = 8.5 cm; uncertainty = 0.1 + 0.1 = 0.2 cm
x = 8.5 ± 0.2 cm

book_ref.quote: Absolute uncertainties are added.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Tafreeq (minus) mein bhi uncertainties hamesha jama hoti hain, kabhi minus nahi hotin, kyun ke dono readings ki ghalti mil kar barh sakti hai.

blocks.prompt:
56 V = 6.0 ± 0.2 V and I = 1.50 ± 0.05 A. Find the resistance R = V/I with its uncertainty.
(V = 6.0 ± 0.2 V aur I = 1.50 ± 0.05 A hai. Resistance R = V/I uncertainty ke saath maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: Percentage uncertainties are added. For example, the maximum possible uncertainty

blocks.prompt:
57 Why is the uncertainty in a result recorded to only one significant figure?
(Natije ki uncertainty sirf aik significant figure tak kyun likhi jaati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke uncertainty sirf aik andaza (estimate) hai. Is liye isay aik significant figure tak likhte hain, maslan R = 5.0 ± 0.5 ohm.

book_ref.quote: uncertainty being an estimate only, is recorded by one significant figure.

blocks.prompt:
58 The radius of a circle is r = 2.00 ± 0.01 cm. Find its area A = πr² with uncertainty.
(Aik daire (circle) ka radius r = 2.00 ± 0.01 cm hai. Is ka area A = πr² uncertainty ke saath maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: The percentage uncertainty is multiplied by the power factor in the formula.

blocks.prompt:
59 Why does a quantity raised to a power in a formula need a more precise measurement?
(Formula mein power wali quantity ko zyada precise naapne ki zaroorat kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Us quantity ki percentage uncertainty us ki power se zarb hoti hai (maslan r² ke liye 2, r³ ke liye 3). Is se precision ki maang barh jaati hai, is liye aisi quantity zyada precise aale se naapni chahiye.

book_ref.quote: As uncertainty is multiplied by power factor, it increases the precision demand of measurement.

blocks.prompt:
60 Light takes 8 min 20 s to travel from the Sun to the Earth. Find the Sun-Earth distance. (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)
(Roshni Sooraj se Zameen tak 8 min 20 s mein pohanchti hai. Sooraj aur Zameen ka faasla maloom karein. (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: Travel time of light (For your information)

blocks.prompt:
61 Why do length, height, diameter and light year have the same dimension?
(Length, height, diameter aur light year ki dimension aik jaisi kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dimensions quantity ki nau'iyat (qualitative nature) batati hain. Length, height, diameter aur light year sab metre mein naape jaate hain, is liye sab ki dimension length [L] hai.

book_ref.quote: The quantities such as length, depth, height, diameter, light year are all measured in metre and denoted by the same dimension

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Light year waqt nahi, faasla hai: roshni aik saal mein jitna faasla tay kare. Is liye is ki dimension [L] hai, [T] nahi.

blocks.prompt:
62 Write the five basic dimensions with their symbols. Why are they chosen as basic?
(Paanch bunyadi (basic) dimensions un ke symbols ke saath likhein. Inhein bunyadi kyun chuna gaya?)
blocks.explanation:
Length [L], mass [M], time [T], electric current [A] aur temperature [θ].
Inhein is liye chuna gaya ke tajurbaat mein inhein naapna aasan hai.

book_ref.quote: These five dimensions have been chosen as being basic because they are easy to measure in experiments.

blocks.prompt:
63 Find the dimensions of (i) power (ii) pressure.
((i) power (ii) pressure ki dimensions maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Power = work/time: [ML²T⁻²]/[T] = [ML²T⁻³]
(ii) Pressure = force/area (raqba): [MLT⁻²]/[L²] = [ML⁻¹T⁻²]

book_ref.quote: The dimensions of other quantities indicate how they are related to the basic quantities and are combination of fundamental dimensions.

blocks.prompt:
64 Write the dimensions of (i) density (ii) electric charge.
((i) density (ii) electric charge ki dimensions likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Density (kasafat) = mass/volume: [M]/[L³] = [ML⁻³]
(ii) Electric charge = current × time (C = A s): [A][T] = [AT]

book_ref.quote: Similarly, the other fundamental quantities, mass, time, electric current and temperature are denoted by specific symbols [M], [T], [A] and [θ], respectively.

blocks.prompt:
65 State the principle of homogeneity.
(Principle of homogeneity (yaksaaniyat ka usool) bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Equation (muadla) tabhi durust hai jab us ke dono taraf quantities ki dimensions aik jaisi hon. Is tarah equation ki durusti check karna principle of homogeneity kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: Correctness of an equation can be checked by showing that the dimensions of quantities on both sides of the equation are the same.

blocks.prompt:
66 Show that the equation vf = vi + at is dimensionally correct.
(Sabit karein ke equation vf = vi + at dimension ke lihaz se durust hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Baayein taraf: [vf] = [LT⁻¹]
Daayein taraf: [vi] = [LT⁻¹]; [a][t] = [LT⁻²][T] = [LT⁻¹]
Dono taraf dimensions [LT⁻¹] hain, is liye equation dimension ke lihaz se durust hai.

book_ref.quote: This shows that dimensions on both sides of equation are the same, therefore, the equation is dimensionally correct.

blocks.prompt:
67 Why is the factor ½ ignored when checking the homogeneity of S = ½at²?
(S = ½at² ki homogeneity check karte waqt ½ ko kyun chhor dete hain?)
blocks.explanation:
½ jaise numbers ki koi dimension nahi, is liye inhein chhor dete hain.
[S] = [L]; [a][t²] = [LT⁻²][T²] = [L], is liye equation homogeneous hai.

book_ref.quote: Numerical factors like 1/2 have no dimensions, so they can be ignored.

blocks.prompt:
68 Check whether the equation S = vt² is dimensionally correct.
(Check karein ke equation S = vt² dimension ke lihaz se durust hai ya nahi.)
blocks.explanation:
Baayein taraf: [S] = [L]
Daayein taraf: [v][t²] = [LT⁻¹][T²] = [LT]
[L] ≠ [LT], is liye equation dimension ke lihaz se durust nahi.

book_ref.quote: This is known as principle of homogeneity.

blocks.prompt:
69 State two limitations of dimensional analysis.
(Dimensional analysis ki do hudood (limitations) bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Yeh nahi bata sakta ke equation mein ghalti kahan hai.
(ii) Yeh numbers ya constants ko check nahi karta, is liye dimension ke lihaz se durust equation sirf shayad durust ho, sabit nahi hoti.

book_ref.quote: The dimensional method cannot identify where an equation is wrong.

blocks.prompt:
70 Can the value of the constant in a formula be found by dimensional analysis? How is it found?
(Kya dimensional analysis se formula ke constant ki qeemat maloom ho sakti hai? Yeh kaise maloom hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Constant ki koi dimension nahi, is liye dimensional analysis us ki adadi qeemat nahi deta. Yeh tajurbaat se (ya variables ke darmiyan munasib graph bana kar) maloom hoti hai, maslan F = mv²/r mein constant 1 hai.

book_ref.quote: The numerical value of the constant cannot be determined by dimensional analysis. However, it can be found by experiments.

blocks.prompt:
71 The speed v of a freely falling body depends on the height h of fall and the acceleration g. Derive the formula for v by dimensions.
(Azadana girte jism ki speed v girne ki unchai h aur acceleration g par munhasir hai. Dimensions se v ka formula derive karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Farz karein v = (constant) hᵃgᵇ: [LT⁻¹] = [L]ᵃ[LT⁻²]ᵇ = [Lᵃ⁺ᵇT⁻²ᵇ]
T: −2b = −1, b = ½; L: a + b = 1, a = ½
v = (constant) √(gh)

book_ref.quote: Dimensionality can be used to derive a possible formula for a physical quantity by correct estimation of various factors on which the quantity depends.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Tareeqa: dono taraf har dimension (L, M, T) ki power barabar rakhein, jitne unknowns utni equations banayein. Constant ki qeemat is tareeqe se nahi milti.

blocks.prompt:
72 What is used as the primary standard for the unit of time?
(Waqt ki unit ka bunyadi (primary) standard kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: National Institute of Standards and Technology, Colorado (USA) mein cesium atomic frequency standard (atomic clock) waqt ki unit ka primary standard hai.

book_ref.quote: It is the primary standard for the unit of time.
